RTGS.description: PSC Rating Group Setting (RTGS). Fields are driven by the selected rating group, its check position, and the condition factor for PSC load rating per AASHTO LRFR19.

GROUP.description: Selected Rating Group name. Must match the group resolved from the Assign key; the group must already exist.

FACTOR.description: Condition Factor. Allowed range (0, 1]. Defaults to 1.0.
